verdict.rationale: Swell has no llms.txt file (404 confirmed by probe), but it does publish dedicated agent-oriented documentation — a /ai page describing how 'your agent picks up the file contract, the CLI and the validate-deploy-verify loop' plus a public swellstores/skills repo of markdown agent skills installable as a Claude Code plugin marketplace. This satisfies the 'agent-oriented docs' half of the story but not the llms.txt convention specifically. Missing for 10: an actual llms.txt endpoint, broader multi-agent (not just Claude) tooling evidence, and independent confirmation the skills repo is actively used by agents.
